company_news.headline: Warner Bros. Stock Hits Lowest Price Since Paramount Deal: Merger Odds Around 50%
company_news.summary: Warner Bros. Discovery  stock Monday hit its lowest point since the company’s merger with  Paramount Skydance  was reached in February as Wall Street appears to be putting little more than a 50% chance that the deal will get done.  Warner Bros. stock dropped 1.8% Monday to $25.28, ending about 18% below the $31-a-share cash offer from Paramount, whose stock also declined Monday.  Warner Bros. stock had been trading around $27 in June.
